meta.purpose: Prompts that imply one entity without naming it, used to build that entity's bridge probe (mean final-token residual). Each prompt ends just before a one-word answer.
rules: The entity's name (or its plural) never appears in its prompts, and neither does the name of any entity it is swapped with.
No answer is one of the 97 entities.
Each prompt cues the entity differently: no content bigram appears in more than 3 of an entity's prompts.
No prompt shares a content 4-gram (function words removed) with any of the 90 probe-swap test prompts, or a content 3-gram with the test prompts that cue the same entity.

No answer (and no prompt word) equals an answer that the test items expect from that entity (its answer when it is the bridge, its swap answer when it is the swap target), so a probe cannot carry the test answer directly.
Cues also avoid paraphrases of the test prompts' own cues for that entity and answer-adjacent words (e.g. 'fifth month' for May).
Answers vary across an entity's prompts; 'answers' lists accepted one-word alternatives, compared with the first word of Qwen's greedy continuation.
